title: Warnings Against Idolatry

questions.question: If a prophet or dreamer arises and gives a sign that comes to pass, saying "Let us go after other gods," what should you do?
options: You shall not listen to the words of that prophet
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not listen to the words of that prophet
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:1–3 (ESV): "...you shall not listen to the words of that prophet or that dreamer of dreams. For the LORD your God is testing you..."

questions.question: Why does God allow such false prophets?
options: To test you, to know whether you love the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: To test you, to know whether you love the LORD
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:3 (ESV): "For the LORD your God is testing you, to know whether you love the LORD your God with all your heart..."

questions.question: What is the penalty for that prophet or dreamer?
options: He shall be put to death
questions.correctAnswer: He shall be put to death
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:5 (ESV): "But that prophet or that dreamer of dreams shall be put to death..."

questions.question: If a close relative secretly entices you to serve other gods, what must you do?
options: You shall not yield to him or listen to him
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not yield to him or listen to him
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:8 (ESV): "you shall not yield to him or listen to him, nor shall your eye pity him..."

questions.question: Who should be first to put their hand to execute the enticer?
options: Your hand shall be first against him
questions.correctAnswer: Your hand shall be first against him
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:9 (ESV): "But you shall kill him. Your hand shall be first against him to put him to death..."

questions.question: If an entire city has gone after other gods, what must be done?
options: Strike the inhabitants with the edge of the sword and burn the city
questions.correctAnswer: Strike the inhabitants with the edge of the sword and burn the city
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:15–16 (ESV): "you shall surely put the inhabitants of that city to the sword... You shall gather all its spoil... and burn the city..."

questions.question: What happens to the spoil of a city devoted to destruction due to idolatry?
options: It shall be a whole burnt offering to the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: It shall be a whole burnt offering to the Lord
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:16 (ESV): "...and burn the city and all its spoil with fire as a whole burnt offering to the Lord your God."

questions.question: The condemned city shall be a heap forever and never be what?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:16 (ESV): "...It shall be a heap forever. It shall not be built again."

questions.question: Who are "worthless fellows"?
options: Those who draw away inhabitants to serve other gods
questions.correctAnswer: Those who draw away inhabitants to serve other gods
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:13 (ESV): "that certain worthless fellows have gone out among you and have drawn away the inhabitants of their city..."

questions.question: Why is the punishment so severe (death)?
options: So all Israel shall hear and fear and never again do such wickedness
questions.correctAnswer: So all Israel shall hear and fear and never again do such wickedness
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:11 (ESV): "And all Israel shall hear and fear and never again do any such wickedness as this among you."

questions.question: What specific family members are mentioned as potential enticers?
options: Brother, son, daughter, wife, or friend
questions.correctAnswer: Brother, son, daughter, wife, or friend
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:6 (ESV): "If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son or your daughter or the wife you embrace or your friend..."

questions.question: When investigating a report of an idolatrous city, what must be done first?
options: Inquire and make search and ask diligently
questions.correctAnswer: Inquire and make search and ask diligently
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:14 (ESV): "then you shall inquire and make search and ask diligently..."

questions.question: Nothing of the "devoted things" shall stick to your hand so that what happens?
options: The Lord may turn from the fierceness of his anger
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord may turn from the fierceness of his anger
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:17 (ESV): "None of the devoted things shall stick to your hand, that the Lord may turn from the fierceness of his anger..."

questions.question: The prophet has taught rebellion against whom?
options: The Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord your God, who brought you out of Egypt
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:5 (ESV): "because he has taught rebellion against the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt..."

questions.question: How were they to kill the enticer?
options: Stone him to death with stones
questions.correctAnswer: Stone him to death with stones
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 13:10 (ESV): "You shall stone him to death with stones, because he sought to draw you away..."

key_verse_text: You shall walk after the LORD your God and fear him and keep his commandments and obey his voice, and you shall serve him and hold fast to him. (ESV)
